1. (Original) An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece so as to direct at least visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently Amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, further comprising __a removable fastener__ for __removably__ attaching said light source to said handpiece.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently Amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, further comprising __a removable fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece, and a battery mounted at least indirectly to said handpiece and operatively connected to said light source__.

8. (Currently Amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source includes __a light-emitting diode (LED)__.

9. (Currently Amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising __an optical fiber extending from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece and a removable fastener for removably attaching said optical fiber to said handpiece__.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently Amended) An accessory for a surgical instrument comprising a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece, and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator, said accessory comprising: a light source; __a removable fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece__; and __a battery operatively connectable to said light source__.

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Cancelled)

14. (Currently Amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein __said battery is removably mountable to said handpiece__.

15. (Currently Amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said light source includes __a light-emitting diode (LED)__.

16. (Currently Amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein __said removable fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber and at least one additional removable fastener for removably attaching said optical fiber to said handpiece so that said optical fiber extends from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece__.

17. (Currently Amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein __said removable fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a distal end of said handpiece and for orienting said light source to provide illumination along said probe to a surgical site__.

18. (Currently Amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein __said removable fastener is taken from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band__.

19. (Currently Amended) A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying __a removable fastener__ to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directable __along__ said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

20. (Currently Amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 further comprising removably mounting __a battery__ at least indirectly to said handpiece.

21. (Cancelled)

22. (Cancelled)

23. (Currently Amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19, further comprising removing __said removable fastener and said light source__ from said handpiece after completion of an operation on said surgical site.

24. (Currently Amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 wherein the applying of __said removable fastener__ includes positioning said light source at a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising attaching an optical fiber to said handpiece so that said fiber extends from said light source at said proximal end of said handpiece to a distal end of said handpiece.

25. (Cancelled)
